sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: Before going to the supermarket, Khaled checked the kitchen and prepared a short list of things to buy. Khaled said, “I need to buy a few groceries.” His friend replied, “Let me write a shopping list.” Khaled said, “We are running out of milk.” His friend replied, “Do we have enough rice?” Khaled said, “I will check the kitchen first.” His friend replied, “We need eggs and vegetables.” Khaled said, “Do not forget the fresh fruit.” His friend replied, “Where is the nearest supermarket?” Khaled said, “It is around the corner.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: A useful exchange
paragraphs: As they continued, they learned to explain what they needed. Khaled said, “I will take a shopping basket.” His friend replied, “Where can I find the bread?” Khaled said, “The bakery section is on the right.” His friend replied, “Are these tomatoes fresh?” Khaled said, “I would like one kilogram, please.” His friend replied, “This package is too large.” Khaled said, “Is there a smaller size?” His friend replied, “Could you check the expiry date?” Khaled said, “This product expires next month.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Making it clearer
paragraphs: They listened, asked questions, and tried the next useful expressions. Khaled said, “Does this drink have added sugar?” His friend replied, “I will choose the unsweetened one.” Khaled said, “Let us compare the prices.” His friend replied, “This item is on sale today.” Khaled said, “That brand is a little cheaper.” His friend replied, “I prefer to buy fresh food.” Khaled said, “We have everything on the list.” His friend replied, “I think I forgot the coffee.” Khaled said, “Let us go back to that aisle.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Ending well
paragraphs: Before leaving, they finished the conversation warmly. Khaled said, “Where are the checkout counters?” His friend replied, “There is a short line over there.” Khaled said, “Would you like a reusable bag?” His friend replied, “Yes, please put everything in it.” Khaled said, “Can I pay with my card?” His friend replied, “Thank you, keep the receipt.” Khaled said, “Now let us put the groceries away.” They felt more confident after practising together.
